beginner.title: Get started with Norton 360
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Norton 360, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Set it up right
beginner.outcome: You can: install and configure Norton 360
beginner.practice: Set up Norton 360 and store recovery details safely

beginner.title: Everyday use
beginner.outcome: You can: use Norton 360 without friction
beginner.practice: Use Norton 360 for a week on your main accounts

intermediate.title: Protect what matters most
intermediate.outcome: You can: secure your critical accounts

intermediate.title: Spot scams
intermediate.outcome: You can: recognise phishing and fraud

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Norton 360
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Norton 360 distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Norton 360
expert.outcome: You can: use Norton 360's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Help family or team
expert.outcome: You can: roll out good security habits to others
expert.practice: Help two people set up Norton 360

expert.title: Integrate Norton 360 into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Norton 360 with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Norton 360 to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Norton 360 well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Norton 360" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
